properties.title: Land Use Land Cover (NRSC)
properties.description:
Annual Land Use Land Cover maps for India built by National Remote Sensing Center, Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) and available on India Water Resources Information System (WRIS) [portal](https://indiawris.gov.in/wris/#/).

The annual maps are available from 2005 onwards at 56m resolution.
 
Following classes exist in the map: 
1. Built Up
2. Cropland -  Kharif
3. Cropland - Rabi
4. Cropland - Zaid
5. Cropland - Double/Triple
6. Fallow Land - Current Fallow
7. Agriculture Plantation - Plantation
8. Forest - Evergreen/Semi-Evergreen
9. Forest - Deciduous
10. Forest - Degraded/Scrub
11. Forest - Littoral Swamp
12. Natural - Grassland
13. Other - Shifting Cultivation
14. Wasteland
15. Sandy Area - Rann
16. Waterbodies - Max
17. Waterbodies - Min
18. Snow Covered / Glacial Area
